spans.s:
f. (-रा)
A sort of beet, (Beta Bengalensis.)

r. 1st cl. (-भषति)
1 To bark or growl.
2 To reproach, to speak malevolently, to rail.

m. (-षः)
A dog.
f. (-षी)
A bitch.
E.
भष to bark. aff. अच्.

r. 3d cl. (वभस्ति)
1 To shine.
2 To blame or abuse; this root is usually restricted to the Vedas.

(ऋ) भाषृ r. 1st cl. (भाषते)
To speak: with परि prefixed, to explain, to expound; with सम्, to discourse, to converse.

Speech.
2

Common or vernacular speech.
3 SARASVATĪ, the goddess of speech.
4 One of the Rāgiṇīs.
E.
भाष to speak, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

(ऋ) भासृ r. 1st cl. (भासते)
To shine.
With प्र and नि prefixed,
To appear to, to seem likely or probable to.

mf. (-सः-सा)
Light, lustre, shining.
m. (-सः)
1 A vulture.
2 A sort of bird, described as a water-fowl.
3 A cock.
4 A station of cowherds.
E.
भास to shine, अप् aff.

m. (-कः)
A dog.
E.
भष to bark, वुन् aff.; it is sometimes written भसक.

n. (-णं)
Barking.
E.
भष to bark, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-णं)
1 Speaking, speech.
2 Declaration of satisfaction at the end of a drama.
E.
भाष to speak, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-त्)
1 The heart.
2

Wood.
3
The thigh.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Speaking, saying.
E.
भाष, and शतृ aff.

f. (-सद्)
1 The sun.
2 Pudendum muliebre.
3 The mons veneris.
4

Time.
5

A sort of duck.
6 A float, a raft.
E.
भस to shine, अदि Uṇādi aff.

m. (-नः)
A large bee.
E.
भस to sound, युच् aff.

m. (-न्तः)
Time.
E.
भस to shine, aff. झच्^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
1 Beautiful, handsome.
2 Shining, splendid.
m. (-न्तः)
1 The sun.
2 The moon.
3 A kind of waterfowl.
mf. (-न्तः-न्ती)
A star.
E.
भास to shine, झच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-तं)
Ashes.
E.
भस to shine, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spoken, uttered, said.
n. (-तं)
Speech.
E.
भाष to speak, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
An astronomer or astrologer.
E.
भ a star, सूचक an intelligencer.

f. (-का)
A bellows.
E.
कन् added to भस्त्रा; also भस्त्रिका, and भस्त्राका.

f. (-का)
A bellows: see the last.

f. (-स्त्रा)
A bellows, a large hide with valves, and a clay nozzle, which is used for this purpose.
E.
भस to shine, त्रन Uṇādi aff., fem. aff. टाप्; also with ङीष् aff. भस्त्री, and with कन् in the fem. form added भस्त्रका or भस्त्रिका optionally; and with the feminine termination retained also, भस्त्राका.

mf. (-कः-की)
A bellows-blower, &c.
m. (-कः)
An inflated skin on which rafts, &c. are floated.
f. (-का)
A bellows: see भस्त्र.
E.
भस्त्र a bellows, and ठन् aff.

f. (-स्त्री)
A bellows: see भस्त्रा, &c.

n. (-कं)
1 A disease of the eyes, thickening of the membranes, and indistinctness of vision.
2 Morbid appetite, constant craving for food, with general decay.
3 An anthelmintic plant, commonly

Bireng.
4

Gold.
E.
भस्मन् ashes, कन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A washerman.
E.
भह्मन् ashes, and कार agent; using the ashes of wood in place of soap or ley.

f. (-का)
A perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
E.
भस्मन् ashes, and गन्ध smell, aff. कन्, and टाप्; also भस्मगन्धिनी.

f. (-र्भ)
1 The Sisu tree, or a variety of it, (Dalbergia Sisu.)
2 A sort of perfume, commonly Reṇukā.
E.
भस्म ashes, and गर्भ place of production.

n. (-लं)
1 A number of villages.
2 A shower of dust.
3 Frost or snow.
E.
भस्म ashes, तूल to weigh, and aff. क.

n. (-स्म)
Ashes.
E.
भस to shine, Uṇādi aff. मनिन्.

m. (-कः)
Camphor.
E.
भस्म ashes, and वेधक distresser; whiter than ashes.

ind.
Ashes, to ashes, as स भस्मसाच्चकारारीन् He reduced the enemies to ashes.
E.
भस्मन्, and साति aff.

m. (-यः)
Camphor.
E.
भस्मन् ashes, आह्वय a name.

n. (-णं)
1 Reducing to ashes.
2 Calcining.
E.
भह्म, and करण doing, च्चि aug.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reduced to ashes.
2 Calcined, (as a metal.)
E.
भस्म, and कृत made, with च्चि aug.; also भस्मकृत and भस्मसात्कृत.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reduced to ashes.
2 Being mere ashes, i. e. being wholly worthless.
E.
भस्मन्, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Speaking, saying.
E.
भाष to speak, शानच् aff.

n. (-दं)
The plaint, the charge, the first of the four divisions of a law suit.
E.
भाषा speech, averment, and पाद quarter, division.

m. (-मः)
A figure of rhetoric, arrangement of a sentence so that it is both Sanscrit and Prākṛta.
E.
भाषा, and सम same.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
To be said or spoken.
n. (-ष्यं)
1 A commentary, but particularly the explanation and application of a technical Sūtra or aphorism; hence applied to many of the annotations on the grammatical aphorisms of PĀṆINI, to comments on the Vedas, &c.
2 A sort of building.
E.
भाष to speak, यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
A commentator or expounder of technical texts or aphorisms; commonly applied as an epithet of PĀTAÑJALI, the author of the Mahābhāṣya or commentary on the annotations of KĀTYĀYANA, on PĀṆINI'S grammatical aphorisms.
E.
भाष्य as above, and कार who makes; also with कृत्, भाष्यकृत्, the same.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being spoken to or addressed.
E.
भाष to speak, pass. v., शानच् aff.

Light.
2

A ray of light.
3 Wish, desire.
E.
भास to shine, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Shining, radiant.
E.
भास to shine, शतृ aff.

n. (-सः)
Light, lustre.
E.
भास to shine, असुन् aff.

m. (-सुः)
The sun.
E.
भास to shine, Uṇādi aff. उ.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Shining, splendid.
n. (-रं)
A species of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
m. (-रः)
1

Crystal.
2

A hero.
E.
भास to shine, घुरच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Resplendent, shining.
m. (-रः)
1 The sun.
2

Fire.
3

A hero.
4 The name of a celebrated astronomer.
n. (-रं)
Gold.
E.
भा light, and कृ to make, अच् aff., and स inserted.

n. (-यं)
The ruby.
E.
भास्कर the sun, and प्रिय fond of.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
Luminous, splendid, shining.
m. (-स्वान्)
1 The sun.
2

Light.
3

A hero.
f. (-स्वता)
The city of the sun.
E.
भास् light, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Shining, radiant.
m. (-रः)
1 The sun.
2 A day.
n. (-रं)
A sort of Costus, (C. speciosus.)
E.
भास् to shine, वरच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Ashy, ashen, made or consisting of ashes.
E.
भस्मन्, and अण् aff.
